name: seo-link-reclaim
summary: Identify broken, lost, redirected, orphaned, or unlinked external-link candidates and route safe reclaim recommendations.
inputs: market, date range, and reclaim scope
approved backlink, competitor, crawl, redirect, CMS, server-log, analytics, and user evidence
writes: Home.md review link when review is required
external_reads: approved crawler, first-party, CMS, redirect, server-log, or manual evidence
approval_gates: provider_availability: run bounded read-only checks against approved integration surfaces; do not reveal secrets or probe arbitrary services
external_read: ask before live provider, Common Crawl, external page, or publisher reads
provider_data: paid or credentialed calls require applicable approval
outreach: contact or pitch actions require a separate approved workflow
external_mutation: redirects, CMS, code, disavowals, outreach, publishing, provider configuration, and production are out of scope
done_when: domain, target pages, market, date range, and scope are explicit
source status, freshness, historical/current status, and verification method are recorded
missing provider data is not presented as proof that a link never existed
each candidate has evidence, least-destructive action, owner, and recheck
redirect, CMS, Development, Writing, Strategy, and outreach handoffs are explicit
no external contact, production mutation, or outcome guarantee occurred
durable artifact uses project/client/prospect routing and review frontmatter
seo-quality-gate passes or is explicitly deferred with an actionable reason
verification: verify unavailable providers produced no fabricated link history or status
verify paid or credentialed calls had approval
verify no redirect, CMS, code, disavowal, outreach, publishing, or production mutation occurred
verify changed Markdown/frontmatter and Home review registration when applicable
